title: Pay & terms
subtitle: Rates and terms, kept in one place your nanny can see too.
appendOnlyNote: Terms are never edited or removed — a change is a new record.
notAvailableDescription: Pay & terms is managed by a parent on this household.
noCarerDescription: Invite your nanny, then set their pay terms here.
noArrangementDescription: Set an hourly rate and Steadily can total the week for both of you.

terms.cancellationsValue: Paid if within {{hours}}h of the start

changeSheet.title: Change terms
changeSheet.dateInvalid: Enter a real date, as YYYY-MM-DD.
changeSheet.dateTooFarAhead: A change can start up to 12 months from today.
changeSheet.backdatingHint: Weeks that are already approved keep their approved totals.
changeSheet.midWeekConsequence: This week will be paid at two rates: {{oldRate}} up to {{oldUntil}}, then {{newRate}} from {{newFrom}}.
changeSheet.overtimeHint: Leave a row blank if it doesn't apply.
changeSheet.dailyOvertimeAfterLabel: Daily overtime after (hours in a day)
changeSheet.dailyOvertimeHint: Paid at the overtime rate above.
changeSheet.doubletimeAfterLabel: Double time after (hours in a day)
changeSheet.seventhDayHint: A seventh day worked in the same week. Its second tier is paid at the double-time rate above.
changeSheet.workedHolidayPremiumHint: Leave blank if a worked holiday pays the normal rate.
changeSheet.mileageHint: Used to price mileage on expenses.
changeSheet.payScheduleHint: This is how weeks are grouped for you to look at. Overtime is always figured week by week, whatever the pay schedule.

preset.title: Common overtime defaults
preset.body: Overtime after 8 hours in a day and 40 in a week, at 1.5×. Double time after 12 hours in a day, at 2×. A seventh consecutive day worked is paid as overtime.
preset.disclaimer: The most common values — a starting point, not legal advice. Check each one against what you've agreed.
preset.checkbox: I'll check these terms are right for our family.
preset.appliedNote: Most common values are populated — check each one and update anything that doesn't match what you've agreed.

outsideWages.hint: These are paid outside the hourly wage. Steadily shows them on the week but never adds them to the week's gross.

inWriting.dutiesPlaceholder: e.g. Care for Mia and Theo, meals and cleanup for the kids, their laundry, school pickup.
inWriting.drivingPlaceholder: e.g. School run in our car; mileage paid for errands.
inWriting.hint: Documentation of what you've agreed. None of it changes what a week pays.

setup.title: Set up pay for {{name}}
setup.subtitle: What you've agreed. {{name}} can see their own terms, and Steadily can total each week for both of you.
setup.cancellationRequiredHint: Choose one — this is the one term with no blank state.

promptCard.title: Finish setting up {{name}}
promptCard.description: Add their pay terms so weeks can be totalled.

myPay.title: My pay
myPay.subtitle: What each family has agreed with you. Only that family can see their own terms.
myPay.emptyDescription: This family hasn't set your rate in Steadily yet. Your hours are still being recorded.
myPay.notAvailableDescription: My pay is for nannies — you're not signed in as one on this account.

markPaidSheet.title: Pay this time off?
markPaidSheet.subtitle: {{name}}, {{range}}
markPaidSheet.hoursHint: How many hours of these days you're paying.
markPaidSheet.hoursError: Enter a number of hours, like 8 or 7.5.
markPaidSheet.overBalanceWarning: This is more than their remaining balance. You can still pay it — the balance will show as {{after}}.
markPaidSheet.adjustHint: Corrections are added as a new line, so the history stays true.

recordPaymentSheet.title: Record a payment
recordPaymentSheet.subtitle: {{name}} · {{range}}
recordPaymentSheet.dateInvalid: Enter a date of today or earlier, as YYYY-MM-DD.
recordPaymentSheet.exceedsGrossTitle: That's more than this week still has left to pay.

consequence.rate: This week is paid at two rates — the old one up to the day before, the new one from this date on.
consequence.weeklyOvertimeOrGuarantee: Overtime and guaranteed hours are figured from the terms in effect on the last day of the week, so this whole week uses the new ones.
consequence.dailyTiers: Daily overtime is figured day by day, so these apply from this date onward. Earlier days in the week keep the old ones.
consequence.cancellations: Cancellation pay is decided against each shift's own start date, so shifts already cancelled keep what they were owed.
consequence.mileage: Mileage already approved keeps the rate it was approved at. Only new approvals use the new rate.
consequence.pto: The yearly grant changes now. Time off already marked paid isn't recalculated.
consequence.holidays: Holidays already worked and approved keep what they paid.
consequence.checkTheWeek: A change partway through a week means this week's total may not match what your payroll service works out. Check the week before you send it.

ack.reassurance: This records the date you saw them. It isn't an agreement to them, and it doesn't give anything up.
ack.recordFailed: That didn't record. Check your connection and try again.

dissent.title: Tell them what's wrong
dissent.hint: This is recorded with the date and your family sees it. It doesn't change the terms, and it doesn't stop them applying — it puts your side on the record.

scheduledChange.title: New terms start {{date}}
scheduledChange.confirmBody: The scheduled change won't take effect. Both the change and this cancellation stay in the history.
scheduledChange.cancelFailed: That didn't go through. If the start date has already arrived, these terms are in effect — change them instead.

correctPaymentSheet.title: Correct this payment
correctPaymentSheet.exceedsOriginalTitle: That's more than this payment has left to reverse.
correctPaymentSheet.notCorrectableTitle: This payment can't be corrected. It may already have been reversed in full, or it is itself a correction.
correctPaymentSheet.note: The original stays on the record. This adds a correcting entry.
